crossRefs.note: When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people…
“Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to…
For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.
Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.
Their bows will dash the young men in pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb. Their eyes will not…
All the people answered, “May his blood be on us, and on our children!”
that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you…

translations.web: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.
translations.bsb: May there be no one to extend kindness to him, and no one to favor his fatherless children.
translations.kjv: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.
translations.asv: Let there be none to extend kindness unto him; Neither let there be any to have pity on his fatherless children.
